verdict.rationale: Teller is a bank-data and payments API with no native automation or workflow feature. Its closest support for background automation is webhooks: Teller sends events when it detects changes in enrollments or financial data, and these are configured from the dashboard. That gives developers a trigger for automations they build and host in their own app, and the idempotent payments endpoint makes automated payment calls safer to retry. Missing for 10: native scheduled or recurring automations, in-product rules or workflow configuration, agent-driven autonomous execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook-driven automation.
